agent_experiment.data_boundary: Only assigned RGB PNGs and public target descriptions. No prior predictions, depth, calibration, source filenames with seeds, result metadata, or replay labels supplied. Shared filesystem restriction is behavioral, not an enforced allowlist.
agent_experiment.sampling: 20 one-shot queries over 20 distinct archived RGB frames; 10 seeds x two distractor counts (0,2). Fixed target schedule then shuffled with RNG seed 925. 18 initial frames and 2 later cylinder frames. Paired scenes are correlated; this is development evidence, not a randomized held-out benchmark.

zoom_transforms.point20_a: All originals; crop [100,90,210,180] at 6x. u=100+x/6, v=90+y/6.
zoom_transforms.point20_b: All originals; crop [100,85,220,175] at 5x. u=100+x/5, v=85+y/5.
zoom_transforms.point20_c: All originals; T03 full-image 3x (u=x/3,v=y/3); other tasks crop [110,80,210,180] at 6x (u=110+x/6,v=80+y/6).

offline_scoring.boundary: Privileged simulator replay segmentation used ONLY after frozen RGB-only predictions, for offline scoring. Not runtime input.
offline_scoring.score_definition: Target hit iff floor(u),floor(v) is in the visible target geom mask; correct abstention iff no target pixels. No snapping or tolerance radius.
offline_scoring.alignment_note: Require matching timestamp, calibration, validity and depth (<=1e-6 m). Replayed RGB is logged separately and is never substituted for actor RGB.

archived_target_masks.usage: Offline scoring evidence only; never a runtime or agent input.
